hooks.command: [ -f "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/graphify-out/graph.json" ] && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify: Knowledge graph exists. Read graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md for god nodes and community structure before searching raw files."}}' || true
hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'graphify-out/graph.json'))) { @{ hookSpecificOutput = @{ hookEventName = 'PreToolUse'; additionalContext = 'graphify: Knowledge graph exists. Read graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md for god nodes and community structure before searching raw files.' } } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress }"
